# Variable `TEST_QEMUBOOT_TIMEOUT`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

The time in seconds allowed for an image to boot before automated runtime tests begin to run against an image. The default timeout period to allow the boot process to reach the login prompt is 500 seconds. You can specify a different value in the `local.conf` file.

For more information on testing images, see the “Performing Automated Runtime Testing” section in the Yocto Project Test Environment Manual.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-TEST_QEMUBOOT_TIMEOUT
